OlinkViz: Visualization Toolkit for Olink Proteomics Data

Source: R/olinkviz-package.R
OlinkViz.Rd

Provides ready-made, publication-quality visualization functions tailored to Olink NPX proteomics data. Includes volcano plots, heatmaps, PCA and UMAP projections, boxplots, dot plots, correlation matrices, and longitudinal trajectory plots.

Data format

Most functions expect data in **long format** (one row per assay per sample) with columns for assay name, NPX value, and sample identifier. Use to_wide() and to_long() to convert between formats. Use validate_npx() to check your data structure.

Plotting functions

  • plot_volcano() — Volcano plots for differential expression

  • plot_heatmap() — Clustered expression heatmaps

  • plot_dim_reduc() — PCA/UMAP/t-SNE projections with group coloring

  • plot_dim_reduc() — PCA, UMAP, and t-SNE projections with group coloring

  • plot_boxplot() — Single- or multi-protein boxplots with stats

  • plot_dotplot() — Multi-protein dot plots with effect sizes

  • plot_corr() — Protein correlation matrices

  • plot_trajectory() — Longitudinal spaghetti plots

  • plot_bridge() — Bridge sample Bland-Altman / scatter comparison

  • plot_plate_qc() — Plate/batch sample median NPX distribution

Bundled datasets

Eleven curated Olink datasets are bundled with the package, spanning Long COVID, primary CNS lymphoma, myasthenia gravis, tuberculosis, and Down syndrome studies. See data(package = "OlinkViz") for the full list.

Shiny app

run_shiny() launches an interactive dashboard for exploring built-in datasets or uploading your own.
